decision: reverse engineered Cursor pstack 0.15.36 from the plugin tree, the cursor-team-kit tree, and the Cursor CLI 2026.10.22 bundle and live probes
why: the user asked for parity from a fresh understanding, not from earlier parity claims

decision: captured Cursor's exact Task schema, TodoWrite/SwitchMode/GenerateImage/AwaitShell schemas, subagent types, model allowlist, notification texts, and custom-mode texts
why: model-facing text and schemas decide agent behavior, so they are the spec

decision: recorded 15 behavior gaps with Cursor evidence and a falsifiable done predicate
why: each gap needs a check that compares old and new behavior

decision: baseline: pi-pstack suite green before any change (45 files, 612 passed, 8 skipped)
why: a change must be measured against the pre-change state

decision: sequenced units riskiest first: mode lifecycle, Task texts, subagent reminder and explore, TodoWrite, path-skills removal, GenerateImage, plan mode, loop coalescing, text fixes, docs
why: mode and Task texts touch every pstack run; plan mode and loop are narrower

decision: kept the mode body in a system-prompt section every request instead of a one-time message
why: a section survives compaction and restarts with no tracking, and Pi patches only changed sections, so a stable body costs nothing per turn
evidence: pi-ai utils/transcript.js collapseSystemMessages; pi-coding-agent system-prompt.js diffSystemPromptSections

decision: moved raw Cursor probe output out of git to .audit/pi-pstack-behavior-parity/cursor-evidence and added probe-cursor.sh to regenerate it; supersedes the evidence paths in the first two rows
why: the raw output and bundle excerpts are Cursor's proprietary prompt text and code, which a public MIT repo should not carry

decision: mode skill rides every request in pstack_mode_skill; pstack_mode carries Cursor's entered, reminder, and exit or switch notices; lifecycle replays from the branch
why: Cursor keeps a Custom Mode's skill in context all session and sends these three notices; pi-pstack dropped the body after one run
evidence: commit bbb435c0; test/e2e/mode.e2e.test.ts fails 3/6 on the old code, passes 6/6 on the new

decision: matched Cursor's background notification (wrapper, preamble, prompt-line title, follow-up request), background and Agent ID texts, and carried Cursor's Task and model-list rules in Pi's descriptions
why: the model acts on these texts; Cursor's exact strings came from live probes, and long tool prose was restated in my words because it is Cursor's proprietary text
evidence: commit 33b774e6; test/task-format.test.ts red 6 then green; test/e2e/task.e2e.test.ts green

decision: added the built-in explore type (search tools on, no Task), restored team-kit's thermo-nuclear orchestration paragraph, and gave every child Cursor's subagent reminder minus its Canvas sentence
why: Cursor lists explore and tells subagents not to spawn unless asked; a Pi poteto-agent could otherwise fan out where Cursor's would not
evidence: commit 7c9d6124; test/e2e/task.e2e.test.ts explore and reminder cases

decision: turned on grep, find, and ls for explore children
why: a first run showed Pi children start without grep and find, while Cursor's explore has Glob and Grep
evidence: test/e2e/task.e2e.test.ts explore case failed on grep, then passed

decision: TodoWrite description carries Cursor's todo rules; kept Pi's lenient merge schema (content and status optional on merge, one item allowed)
why: the rules steer how a playbook todo list is kept; Cursor's minItems 2 and required fields would only add failed calls
evidence: commit a57ca8ef; test/e2e/host.e2e.test.ts declared tool descriptions: TodoWrite red on old todo.ts, green on new

decision: deleted src/path-skills.ts and its test; typescript-best-practices now loads only by name
why: Cursor never surfaces a paths skill that sets disable-model-invocation (live probe ts-skill-attach.jsonl, cursor.com/docs/skills); pstack ships no other paths skill
evidence: commit a53fb3d3; test/e2e/host.e2e.test.ts typescript case red before the deletion, green after

decision: registered GenerateImage (Cursor's description, filename, reference_image_paths, aspect_ratio) on ctx.modelRegistry.generateImages, active only when an image model exists and the session may write; restored teach's upstream sentence
why: Cursor sessions always offer GenerateImage, and pstack's teach and ketchup use it; codemode is off by default in Pi
evidence: commit e608a416; test/e2e/host.e2e.test.ts image generation cases with test/fixtures/image-model.ts

decision: plan mode: Cursor's instructions, CreatePlan with Cursor's schema and file, markdown-only edit and write, SwitchMode with confirm, and a build-or-propose prompt after a saved plan
why: Cursor's plan mode is the host feature pstack's README says to use alongside it; pi-pstack's version differed in schema, file, edits, and flow

decision: kept plan mode's shell sandbox denying network, unlike Cursor which allows read-only network commands by instruction
why: a sandboxed shell with network turns an enforced read-only guarantee into a path for remote changes and exfiltration; Cursor enforces nothing here

decision: mapped Cursor's build-in-cloud choice to a background isolated worktree worker, offered only in a git repository as Cursor offers it only in a repository
why: pi-pstack already maps environment cloud to a worktree worker; the CLI's plan card shows the cloud option only for a repository
evidence: src/plan.ts agent_settled handler; test/plan.test.ts build-in-a-worker case

decision: a loop wake that lands during a run is marked due and fires once when the run settles; fixed loops keep wall-clock cadence
why: Cursor's monitored shell output notifies after the turn; pi-pstack skipped fixed ticks and lost agent-paced wakes, which stalled the loop for good
evidence: commit 128a0ae9; test/loop.test.ts fake-timer cases red on the old loop.ts, green on the new

decision: did not add concurrent loops (Cursor allows several, one per purpose)
why: pstack's playbooks arm one audit loop at a time; several loops would need named loops in /loop, the Loop tool, and the section, for a case pstack does not exercise

decision: fixed make-bot-ui's routine text: no default expiry, and new_session works for webhooks
why: the skill contradicted src/subscriptions/index.ts expiryOf and the webhook sessionStrategy parameter

decision: AskQuestion: Cursor's usage rules in the description, minItems 1 question and 2 options
why: captured Cursor's AskQuestion contract in plan mode, where it is a direct tool; pi-pstack lacked the (Recommended) and prefer-the-tool conventions

decision: updated README, parity-status, native-gaps, CHANGELOG; bumped 0.15.36-pi.12; reworded README rows that named Cursor
why: the repository's RES-012 gate keeps shipped text in Pi terms, and parity-status is the one file that records the upstream comparison
evidence: commit 3231eff1; test/resources.test.ts RES-012 red on the first README draft, green after

decision: full package gate: typecheck clean, test:coverage 45 files 634 passed 8 skipped, biome ci clean, check-pi-mechanisms clean, check:tests 0 violations
why: each unit was checked alone; this checks them together

decision: ran live-check.mjs with a real model (claude-haiku-4-5) on the new code and on the pre-change commit ca0f25b5
why: the e2e suite uses a scripted model; a real model shows what an agent actually sees and does

why: a check must read the artifact, not a self-report; the H1 rule is model compliance, not file shape

why: Pi runs settle handlers in order, so a loop tick would wait on the user's answer

evidence: git checkout ca0f25b5 && bun run test in extensions/pi-pstack
result: supersedes evidence of the baseline row
